input.quote: 21.1 Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual but the basis is only one month of Fees actually paid — far below the walk-away floor of six months' fees and illusory against a USD 2,000,000 annual take-or-pay commitment (Section 2.1); "Fees" (Section 1.5) also excludes implementation charges, narrowing the base further. Worse, "without exception" overrides the Excluded Claims definition in Section 21.3, pulling indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement inside a one-month cap. The redline sets the cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 and restores the Section 21.3 carve-outs as uncapped; Section 21.2 (mutual consequential-damages exclusion) and 21.3 (payment obligations not damages) already meet the playbook and are untouched.

proposal.summary: Raise the mutual cap to the greater of 12 months' Fees and USD 1,000,000 and place Excluded Claims outside the cap
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We can accept a mutual cap, but our position is the greater of (a) Fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000 — one month of Fees is not a meaningful remedy against a USD 2,000,000 annual commitment. We have also removed "without exception" so that the Excluded Claims already defined in Section 21.3 (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) sit outside the cap, and confirmed Customer's payment obligations are not damages. As a fallback we can live with a mutual cap of 12 months' Fees provided those carve-outs remain uncapped.

ops.oldText: Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, which are not subject to the limitation in this Section 21.1, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
